Apple refreshes MacBook Pro lineup with M5 chips, starting at $1,599

Published 2026-10-07 17:20 UTC

Apple on Wednesday updated its MacBook Pro lineup with the M5, M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, keeping the starting price of the 14-inch model at $1,599. Orders open today, with the laptops arriving in stores on October 15.

The company is pitching the M5 MacBook Pro squarely at developers and creators running AI models locally. Apple says GPU performance is up to 45% higher than the M4 generation thanks to neural accelerators in every GPU core, and unified memory now tops out at 192GB on the M5 Max.

Other changes are incremental: the mini-LED display is brighter outdoors, all configurations get three Thunderbolt 5 ports, and battery life is rated at up to 24 hours on the 16-inch model. The chassis, keyboard and webcam are carried over from last year. Apple did not announce new desktops alongside the laptops.
